title: Check every piece, sell honestly and take photos that sell

say: Check every piece, sell honestly, and take photos that sell.
This is the video for module three of Handmade Accessories for Sale.
Customers judge handmade work by the details: loose threads, glue marks, earrings that do not match.

say: Write a short finishing standard for each product, then check every piece against it. Step one. Inspect in good daylight or under a bright white bulb, never in dim light.

panel.heading: The inspection routine
items: Inspect in daylight or a bright white bulb

say: Step two. Go through your standard line by line, and look at the back as well as the front. For example, ear wires closed with no gap.

panel.heading: The inspection routine
items: Inspect in daylight or a bright white bulb

say: Step three. Give a gentle stress test. Tug each strap, stretch each bracelet, give each ear wire a light pull.

panel.heading: The inspection routine
items: Inspect in daylight or a bright white bulb

say: Step four. Sort it. Sell, fix, or seconds. Sell seconds clearly labelled at a lower price, never mixed with full-price stock.

panel.heading: The inspection routine
items: Inspect in daylight or a bright white bulb

say: Step five. Write down every defect, even if you fix it. Your notes show the pattern.

panel.heading: The inspection routine
items: Inspect in daylight or a bright white bulb
panel.rule: Use checks you can see or measure. "Looks nice" is not a check.

say: For example, Halima in Kano sold 30 stretch bracelets in a month. Four customers said theirs snapped or came undone within two weeks.

say: She was using thin 0.5 mm cord for heavy glass beads, and trimming the ends before the glue was dry.

say: So she changed her recipe card: 0.8 mm cord for beads 8 mm and above, pre-stretch every length, and trim only after the glue has dried.

panel.rule: A repeated defect means change the method.

say: Name materials exactly. For example, Ngozi changed her listing to say gold-tone ear wires, glass beads, and handmade in Aba.
She removed gold, crystal and hypoallergenic, because her supplier could not confirm them. Never claim a metal or stone you cannot confirm.
And never put a famous brand's logo on your work. That makes it a counterfeit, even if you made it by hand.

Nickel is a common cause of skin allergy from jewellery. Offer earrings on confirmed metals for sensitive ears. If a customer reports irritation, advise her to stop wearing it, and offer a replacement on different findings.

panel.heading: Protect the wearer and the buyer

cards.d: Nickel can cause skin allergy. Offer confirmed metals: surgical stainless steel, titanium or sterling silver.
Beads and small parts can choke. Do not make or sell them for babies and young children.
Confirm payment in your own bank or wallet app. Screenshots and SMS alerts can be faked.

say: Beaded jewellery and small parts can choke babies and young children. Do not sell for that age group, and say not suitable for young children where it applies.

say: You do not need a professional camera. Clean the lens with a soft cloth. Use daylight from a window, not direct sun. Use a plain background, the same for every product.

panel.heading: Good photos with just a phone

say: Hold a white card opposite the window to lift shadows. Keep the phone steady, and move closer instead of zooming.
And use no filters that change colours. The buyer must receive what she saw.

panel.heading: Good photos with just a phone

say: Take the same five shots every time. The front on a plain background, and a side or back view.

panel.heading: Five shots of every product
items: Worn or held, to show size

say: A close-up of your finishing.

panel.heading: Five shots of every product
items: Worn or held, to show size

say: One worn or held to show size: earrings on an ear, a tote on a shoulder. Buyers always ask how big it is.

panel.heading: Five shots of every product
items: Worn or held, to show size

say: And the matching set together. Then write your description in the same order each time: name, size, materials, features, care, and price with delivery.

panel.heading: Five shots of every product
items: Worn or held, to show size

say: To remember. Your standard is the worst piece you will sell. Inspect, stress test, sort and record. Name materials honestly. Confirm payment in your own app. And photograph in daylight with no colour filters.
